λ ELI5 Kata · Church Infix All Operations (2 kyu)

How do `2 a d d 3 = 5`, `5 s u b 4 = 1`, `3 m u l 4 = 12`, `5 d i v 2 = 2`, `7 m o d 4 = 3`, `2 p o w 3 = 8` work in λ-calculus where each letter is a combinator?

https://github.com/8b-is/space-bender/tree/main/katas/2kyu/church-infix-all-ops

🧩 ELI5 Step 1 (How Infix Spelling Works):

In λ-calculus, `x c1 c2 c3 y` means `(((x c1) c2) c3) y`!
Since `x` is a Church numeral ("do c1 x times starting from c2"), `x c1 c2` counts `x` steps, and then hands `x` to the 3rd letter `c3` and `y`!

🎭 ELI5 Step 2 (The Triple Agent Letter `d`):

11 of the 12 letters only sit in one slot (`c1`, `c2`, or `c3`).
Only `d` is a triple agent:
• `0 a d d y` → `d d y = y`
• `x d i v y` → `(d^x i) v y = div x y`
• `x m o d y` → `(x m o) d y = mod x y`

`d = \p. p A` solves all 3!

✅ Verified across 626 Church numeral tests (`0 pow 0 = 1`, `add`, `sub`, `mul`, `div`, `mod`, `pow`)!
